offering_description.value: Hudson Technologies supplies new and reclaimed refrigerants, compressed gases and cylinders to HVAC and refrigeration wholesalers, service contractors, facility operators and government buyers. It collects and purifies used refrigerants for resale and provides on-site cleaning and diagnostics for cooling systems.

primary_products.value: new and reclaimed refrigerants; industrial compressed gases; gas cylinders

primary_services.value: refrigerant recovery and reclamation; on-site cooling system decontamination; cooling system diagnostics and energy monitoring

customer_segment.value: B2B: HVAC and refrigeration wholesalers, service contractors and commercial and industrial facility operators; B2G: U.S. military procurement agencies

end_markets.value: commercial air conditioning; commercial refrigeration; industrial process cooling; military facilities

revenue_model.value: product sales: New and reclaimed refrigerants, compressed gases and cylinders; service fees: Refrigerant reclamation, system cleaning, diagnostics and energy monitoring; project or contract: Government contracts for refrigerants, compressed gases and related supply management
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Purifies recovered refrigerants to industry specifications for sale to wholesalers, contractors and facility operators; distributor: Sources new refrigerants, compressed gases and cylinders for commercial and government buyers; service provider: Reclaims refrigerants from contractors and facility operators and services commercial and industrial cooling systems

geography_served.value: US national: Refrigerant supply, collection and field services across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: Refrigerant supply and reclamation, industrial gas supply and cooling system services

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: HVAC and refrigeration wholesalers serving contractors and facility operators; direct sales: Commercial, industrial and government accounts served by Hudson’s sales and field service teams

regulatory_exposure.value: high: EPA certification for refrigerant reclamation under Clean Air Act Section 608 and HFC phasedown rules under the AIM Act

notes: The current status of its U.S. military supply contract is uncertain.
